description: This Java interface defines a contract for handling custom value types within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for retrieving metadata, serializing/deserializing values, and managing the state of custom data objects.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns metadata describing this custom value.

methods.name: getValueReference
methods.description: Retrieves the persisted string value that references the custom data, which may not be human-readable.

methods.name: setValueReferenceInternal
methods.description: Sets the string value to be persisted in the database, validating the value before setting.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the typed value by converting the stored reference string via a CustomDatatype.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the typed value, converting it to the reference string representation.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the value has been modified and needs to be persisted.
